name: Traction Uranium Corp.
summary: Traction Uranium Corp., a Canadian enterprise, is dedicated to the prospecting and identification of mineral deposits. The company holds an exclusive right to purchase the Whitewater Property, which encompasses six distinct claims totaling approximately 2,281.72 hectares, located within British Columbia's Slocan Mining Division. Incorporated in 2020, the firm, headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, rebranded from Traction Exploration Inc. to its current designation, Traction Uranium Corp., in November 2021.
